R-30 — Starting selection brief
Manufacturer: Boya Gongdao

A tethered inspection ROV for visual assessment of submerged structures, with payload and sensor selection matched to the task.

Vehicle weight: 21 kg
Depth rating: 300 m
Payload: 3 kg
Dimensions: 500 × 398 × 356 mm
Camera: 1080p; 4× optical zoom
Camera tilt: ±90°
Power: External tethered supply

Configuration note: Sonar, positioning and task-specific tools require confirmation of compatibility, mounting, power and delivered configuration.

Confirm current specifications and delivered scope with the manufacturer before purchase.
